name: Sail Anchor
description: Draw a rope logic link between four Sail Anchors in a loop to form a sail. A sail will convert force from the wind to the direction of the sail facing. The sail force is strongest when fully facing the wind to act as a parachute, but also has a strong force when facing slightly off a right-angle from the wind to act as a wing. A keel is recommended for sailboats to apply sail forces in a useful direction.
shortDescription: An anchor point for a sail.

logicNodes.label: Take In/Out Sails
logicNodes.description: While active, allows the ropes forming the sail to spool freely.
